data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘al-labab’, which means ‘dewdrop’ or ‘little drops of rain’. The name Lablab carries the meaning “Dewdrop” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lablab usually hope their child will grow to embody dewdrop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
